1924225725-collab/dsh-DKN-Workbench.body:
# dsh-DKN-Workbench

DKN Integration Workbench is a Windows plugin for DeepSeek Harness (formerly DKN Agent). Within DSH, you can browse and continue local Codex project conversations, use CLI models from Codex, CodeBuddy, and ZCode, use local account models through Qoder ACP, and organize agent collaboration by project. The current source is `2.3.7`, compatible with DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` / `0.2.2-rc.3` / `0.2.2-rc.5`.

The interface uses a clean style by default, sharing the same scheduling layout and configuration drawer as the illustrated style. The clean version replaces artwork with icons, connector lines, and light dots, and follows DSH's light and dark themes. You can switch styles in the top-right corner. After an upgrade, it switches to the clean version once and then keeps your choice.

[Download latest version](https://github.com/1924225725-collab/dsh-DKN-Workbench/releases/latest) · [Standalone CodeBuddy version (China CLI)](https://github.com/1924225725-collab/dsh-codebuddy-cli-cn) · [English](https://github.com/1924225725-collab/dsh-DKN-Workbench/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

2.2.6 fixes standalone Node detection under Electron hosts and provides a copyable AI deployment prompt when the environment is missing. The API keeps the full configuration display, and check-in shows that it is waiting for the backend. It also adds host access checks for DSH HTTP routes. See the [runtime environment notes](https://github.com/1924225725-collab/dsh-DKN-Workbench/blob/HEAD/docs/background-environment.md).

## TRAE CN Domestic Personal Edition

2.3.3 adds image input for Qoder ACP, Codex CLI, and Codex project mode, and the unified API supports PNG/JPEG Base64 images. The image channel and text connection tests are validated separately. Antigravity image transmission has been adapted, but the current test account has not passed official eligibility verification. Image recognition on the TRAE remote channel failed in testing, so only text input remains enabled. See the [input capabilities notes](https://github.com/1924225725-collab/dsh-DKN-Workbench/blob/HEAD/docs/input-capabilities.md) for details.

DDDMUC/dsh-delete-session.description: DeepSeek Harness delete-session plugin: moves to the system trash by default, with a switch to permanent deletion; supports drag and batch deletion, safe deletion of active sessions, and cleanup of sub-agent sessions without touching independent forks; output files can be isolated and Git repositories skipped by default; logs and caches are fully cleared, leaving no ghost records.
DDDMUC/dsh-delete-session.body:
# dsh-delete-session
- **Drag to footer to delete** — Drag a conversation from the sidebar directly onto the footer bar. The whole bar turns red and shows “Release to delete「Title」”. On release it follows the “Ask when deleting” setting: if enabled, a confirmation dialog appears; if disabled, the session is deleted immediately. In multi-select mode, dragging still performs the host's row reordering and is not intercepted.

**DeepSeek Harness session deletion plugin — delete sessions directly from the session menu in the sidebar.**

Adds “Delete session” to the session `...` menu (Rename / Fork / Archive) in the DSH Web sidebar, and optionally removes the files produced by that conversation as well.
Deletion goes to the **system trash** by default, so mistakes can be restored. To erase a session permanently, turn off that switch in settings.

[中文](#中文) · [English](#english)

---

## 中文

### Why it's needed

The DSH sidebar session menu only offers **Rename / Fork / Archive**. Archiving only hides a session and **does not delete data**. The “Session archive management” feature in the plugin suite is buried deep in settings, and deleting one session requires navigating several screens.

This plugin puts “delete” back where you click most often: the `...` menu on each session row.

### Features

- **Delete from the menu** — Registered in the host's official slot `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item`, so “Delete session” appears right below “Archive session”. The session ID is injected directly by the host, so it always acts on the row you clicked and **does not switch the current session**.
- **Delete to the system trash (on by default)** — Session logs, workspace bookkeeping, and projection caches all go to the **system trash**: the Windows Recycle Bin, the macOS Trash, or `gio trash` on Linux. If you delete by mistake, restore it from the trash. The settings page lets you turn this off; once off, items are **removed directly from disk and cannot be recovered**.
- **Dialog text follows the switch** — When checked, the dialog says “and move to the system trash”; when unchecked, it says “permanently delete… cannot be recovered”. What you see always matches what will actually happen.
- **Risk confirmation** — Each deletion shows a confirmation dialog with the session title and ID. Whether this dialog appears can **only be changed on the settings page**; there is no quick checkbox in the dialog. **Shift+click** temporarily forces the dialog to appear.
- **Delete child sessions too** — Sub-agents are **independent sessions** (separate directories, separate logs). When the parent is deleted, they would otherwise become orphans left on disk. Deleting now also handles the child sessions the parent spawned: check “Also delete child sessions” in settings to delete them together. If unchecked, the dialog lists the child sessions so you can choose which to delete (all selected by default).
- **Multi-select batch delete** — Choose “Multi-select” in the session menu to enter selection mode. After you select several rows, an action bar appears in the sidebar footer (official `sidebar.footer.action` slot) with “N selected / Cancel / Delete”. The host determines its placement, and it disappears when you exit selection mode. Clicking Delete runs the batch immediately: selected rows are optimistically hidden, and the bar shows progress in real time. The client 6…

JasonZhang1225/BJTUselfService-KMP-Refre.description: Unofficial cross-platform campus service client for Beijing Jiaotong University — making campus study and life more convenient
JasonZhang1225/BJTUselfService-KMP-Refre.body:
# 🚄 交大自由行KMP (BJTU Self Service KMP Refreshed)

> BJTU campus service client — making campus life within reach  ↩
> This repository is the **Kotlin Multiplatform refactored version** (Android / iOS / macOS / Windows).

## 📖 Project Introduction

**交大自由行** is a campus service app built for students and staff of Beijing Jiaotong University. By automatically logging into the MIS system, it brings common campus features such as grade queries, class timetables, exam schedules, assignment management, and email viewing into a single clean, intuitive interface.

Login page parsing, password encryption, and school data parsing are all performed **locally**. Account passwords are not uploaded to any third-party server.

This project ([BJTUselfService-KMP-Refreshed](https://github.com/JasonZhang1225/BJTUselfService-KMP-Refreshed)) builds on the Android version of the original author’s project [HFDLYS/BJTUselfService](https://github.com/HFDLYS/BJTUselfService), using **KMP + Compose Multiplatform** for a shared multi-platform implementation.

This project uses the original `v1.7.1` as its migration baseline and has since been developed independently. It no longer syncs with upstream. Compared with the migration baseline, the KMP version mainly adds:

- **Shared across four platforms**: Android / iOS / macOS / Windows share business logic and most of the UI
- **More assignment sources**: Physics Online (物理在线) and CITEL (written assignments and programming exercises), which can be aggregated with course platforms into a single “Assignments” entry point
- **Physics experiments and demonstration experiments**, and **library borrowing**
- **Desktop widgets, Dynamic Island, and Live Activities** (iOS Dynamic Island / Android 16 Live Updates)
- **Local AI assistant and ChatGPT plugin**: use AI tools to query timetables, grades, and assignments
- **App center and customizable bottom bar**

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

## What is this

Fuyu (浮屿) is a lightweight, borderless, always-on-top floating island. It stays tucked at the top of the screen most of the time, expands when needed, and retracts automatically after use. Frequently used things are kept on the island, so you don't have to switch windows back and forth just to glance at information.

## What's on the island

The island's appearance, size, collapse behavior, shortcut keys, and each feature can be adjusted in the settings window. In-app automatic updates are supported. All data is stored locally on your machine.

## Resource usage

When collapsed, idle, and not playing music (default settings, no plugins installed):

| | Measured |
|---|---|
| CPU | About **10%** of a single core (about 0.5% of total on a 20-core computer) |
| Memory | Fuyu itself, about **16 MB** |
| Agent page refreshing the session list once per second | **0.1%** of a single core |

czg86389-hub/ACP-Ant.description: OpenAI / Anthropic compatible API for Google's official Antigravity CLI over ACP, plus Google AI Studio as an optional second source: multi-account, per-account proxy, tool calling for agents (Codex, LangChain, Cline...)
czg86389-hub/ACP-Ant.body:
# ACP-Ant

Turns Google's official **Antigravity CLI (`agy`)** into a standard LLM interface via the **ACP protocol (Agent Client Protocol)**. **OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, and Anthropic Messages** formats are all supported, including **tool calling (function calling)**, so agents and applications can connect directly.
Supports **multiple Google accounts used in rotation, with each account going through its own proxy node**.
Starting with 1.5.0, you can also connect **Google AI Studio as a second source**: same address, same key. `aistudio/<模型名>` goes to AI Studio and everything else goes to Antigravity. The quota of the same Google account can be used on both sides.

- Uses Google's official command-line program and official protocol. No packet capture, and no reverse-proxying of web login credentials.
- Codex CLI, OpenAI SDK, LangChain, Dify, Cline, OpenCode, and others: as long as they support the OpenAI or Anthropic interface, just enter the address, key, and model name.
- With multiple accounts, traffic is automatically distributed. When an account runs out of quota, gets rate-limited, or requires verification, it automatically switches to the next account.
- **AI Studio second source (optional)**: one command starts [AIStudio2API](https://github.com/Mag1cFall/AIStudio2API). Log in to Google from the panel using a browser on the server. It doesn't depend on your computer, and the session stays valid long-term. Gemini 4 Hydrogen and other AI Studio models are available. See [AI Studio second source](#ai-studio-第二路可选150-起) for details.
- **Web control panel**: add accounts, log in to Google, change proxies, view each account's quota, enable or disable accounts, and run automatic health checks. All of this is done by clicking in the web page, with no commands to type. Antigravity and AI Studio sources are shown on the same account card, grouped by email.

[English](#english)

## 🎬 Recommended: COOL AI, one-stop e-commerce AI video and image creation

Upload a product image and create talking-head sales videos, plot-driven product short dramas, and a complete set of e-commerce detail pages.

- **Talking-head sales videos**: automatically writes scripts, storyboards, and lines, and generates real-person talking-head sales videos in one click
- **Plot-driven sales videos**: reversal short dramas, dialogue short dramas, and plot product placement, with automatic scriptwriting, storyboarding, and output
- **E-commerce detail images**: from one white-background image, generates a full set of main image, scene images, selling-point images, detail images, and comparison images in one click
- **AI images and tools**: product retouching, GIF animation, digital humans, subtitle removal, and image quality enhancement

ef1m03/kordon.description: Kill switch for applications: freezes Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Telegram and other programs when the VPN drops, the network changes, or the IP changes
ef1m03/kordon.body:
## Why

Some programs must not be run "from the wrong" address: work software that should only go through a corporate VPN, AI assistants, messengers, torrent clients. VPNs drop constantly: after sleep, when switching Wi-Fi, during reconnection. At that moment a program is already sending requests from your real IP, and you find out last.

A regular kill switch inside a VPN client cuts off the internet entirely. Kordon works selectively: it only affects the applications you choose and leaves everything else as it is.

exneverbur/astrbot_plugin_virtual_world.description: AstrBot personification plugin: gives the Bot a private space and its own life rhythm. She has her own map, actions, schedule, and scene memory, can call AstrBot's tools at permitted locations, and also walks around, cooks, zones out, and starts conversations with you on her own. Dedicated to giving her a real life.
exneverbur/astrbot_plugin_virtual_world.body:
# Virtual World SOLIS

A state machine that gives a Bot a space, a daily routine, and memory.

## What it is

SOLIS is a plugin running on AstrBot that takes over replies in whitelisted sessions. She is not a responder with a new set of lines. The world clock keeps running. She has her own map and location, her own schedule and routine, a body state and mood that change over time, and memory archived by person. When nobody is talking to her, her life goes on as usual. When you speak, her reply is based on "where she is right now, what she is doing, and what is on her mind."

The plugin is simple to install, adds no extra Python dependencies, and automatically generates a ready-to-use world configuration on first launch.

Everything she does leaves a record, shown in the editor as a readable timeline. What she wanted to do, why she chose to speak at this moment, and why she stayed silent can all be reviewed afterward.

## Features

**She really lives her life.** Movement, cooking, zoning out, sleeping, browsing memories, and looking things up online all happen according to time and state. If a schedule item is due and she is not in the right place, she walks there herself. When sleepy at night, she returns to the bedroom, and when her energy is low, she rests for a while first.

**Emotions change behavior.** Six values (energy, loneliness, curiosity, restlessness, valence, and boredom) keep changing and influence where she goes, what she does, whether she speaks, and what tone she uses. The values are not decoration. The logs show the basis for each round's choices.

**She remembers people.** She remembers who she talked to, where, and what they discussed. She also remembers each person's relationship, affection level, and topics that should not be touched. When the same person returns to the same place, she remembers. Outdated claims that have been overturned are retired, so old and new information is not mixed together.

**She takes initiative.** She greets people according to her schedule, comments briefly on noteworthy events, responds to images with a line of text, and picks a sticker to send. Which session she posts in is decided by who she is currently talking to. Private messages do not appear in groups.

**She can get things done.** Actions can call tools already installed in AstrBot. Image generation, search, sending voice messages, and checking the weather can all become her actions. She can also take on multi-step tasks and return the results as organized deliverables. When information is missing midway, she first answers from her own world knowledge, and only asks you when your decision is truly needed.

**Group nicknames follow her.** Her location and current activity can be written into her group card automatically.

**Stickers are a complete system.** Collected stickers can include descriptions and usage notes, and can be searched by meaning and keywords. Each round, a few are selected as candidates. Images are automatically resized before sending, and static images are converted to GIF to fit client dimensions. A whole collection can be packaged for export and imported elsewhere.

**Everything is visible.** The editor has 14 pages: Dashboard, Agent, Events, Contacts, Memory Library, Logs, Debug, Assets, Map, Action Library, Schedule, Sessions, Global Settings, and Presets.

## Customization

This is where SOLIS has invested the most. Beyond the core state machine, nearly every layer is open for you to modify.

grampr/geyseruploader.body:
# GeyserUpdater

Auto-update plugin for GeyserMC / Floodgate / ViaVersion / ViaBackwards / ViaRewind (1.3.0). Supports Spigot (Paper, etc.), BungeeCord, and Velocity.

Features
- Fetches the latest stable versions of GeyserMC and Floodgate from Jenkins / the download API and overwrites the existing JARs in the plugins directory
- Automatically updates the stable version of ViaVersion / ViaBackwards / ViaRewind that matches the running environment, individually (optional)
- Fetches the latest version of MCXboxBroadcast (Modrinth) and places it in Geyser's extensions folder (optional)
- Automatic update checks
  - On server startup
  - At a specified interval (e.g., every 12 hours)
  - When a player with a specified permission logs in (can be turned ON/OFF)
- Manual command: /geyserupdate (permission: geyserupdater.admin)
- Configuration for language, messages, targets, interval, and restart command
- Restart countdown after an update, and remaining-seconds notifications sent to all online players

Build
- Prerequisites: Java 17, Maven 3.8+
- Steps:
  - Run `mvn package` in the folder you cloned with git
  - Outputs:
    - spigot/target/geyserupdater-spigot.jar
    - bungee/target/geyserupdater-bungee.jar
    - velocity/target/geyserupdater-velocity.jar

Installation
- Place the JAR matching your server into the plugins folder

mamo0521/memory-sky.body:
# Memory Sky · 记忆星穹

> **I was born from every memory of you.**
> *I was born from every memory of you.*
>
> Turn your memories of you and Ta into a starry sky you can look at and read. Each sphere is a memory: size is importance, color is mood, and lines are connections. In the top right, switch to Constellation (星座) and an entire storyline lights up on its own.
>
> Plain JavaScript + Three.js. No framework, no backend, your data never leaves the page.

**👉 [Try it online](https://mamo0521.github.io/memory-sky/)**

## Illustrated Guide

Eight pages, and this is the fastest way to start. The text below has the details: every field, the scoring scale, and the integration code.

---

## What it looks like

- Two looks: **Sky 星穹** is a soft-glowing night sky with galactic stardust and the occasional shooting star. **Riso 印刷纸** is an old sheet of paper with memories printed as ink spheres. Tap the star button in the top right to switch.
- **Tap a sphere**: the camera moves closer, the sphere gets a soft halo, and a name tag appears below it (name · date).
- **Tap the name tag again**: a semi-transparent memory body expands at the bottom. A small line under the title shows the memory's importance and emotional coordinates. Tap × or press Esc to collapse it.
- **Top right +**: change the layout (free starfield / stellar orbit / ring), switch memory constellations, or return to the full map. Under Riso you can also change the core and the bottom gradient; under Sky you can change the background color. When you switch to a constellation, it always renders in that constellation's shape. If you pick a layout while in a constellation, it first returns to all memories and then reshapes.
- On mobile, one finger rotates and two fingers zoom. On desktop, drag to rotate and scroll to zoom. Works in both portrait and landscape.

## How to read a sphere

| What you see | What it is | Determined by |
|---|---|---|
| Spheres vary in size | How heavy this memory is | `importance` 1–5 |
| Spheres come in four colors | What mood this memory carries | `valence` (pleasant −1…1) + `arousal` (excitement 0…1) |
| A large pale blue sphere in the center | The soul core: Ta's base tone. Who Ta is, what your relationship is, and what always holds true. Tap it to read | `kind: 'core'` |
| Thin lines between spheres | Connections you've marked, plus pairwise links between members of the same constellation. The soul core has no lines | `links` / `softlinks` / `families` |

> **Important**
>
> **Players, please go to [Releases](https://github.com/nobell001/YES-BD2/releases/latest) and download `yes-bd2-win32-online-setup.exe` to install.** The `Source code` on the page and the green "Code → Download ZIP" button provide source code, not the installer.

>

> The tool's own interface is available in 5 languages. Switch them in the tool under "Settings → Language".

## Disclaimer

- **Free and open source**: a personal project for learning Python, image recognition, OCR, and UI automation. No fees are charged.
- **Screen-only, simulated mouse**: does not read or modify game memory or game files.
- **Use at your own risk**: automation tools may violate the terms of service of the game or platform. Accounts may be restricted or banned, or rewards may be revoked. Users bear this risk themselves.
- **Unofficial**: not affiliated with the developer, publisher, or platforms of Brown Dust 2.
- **No profit**: no commercial use is accepted, including boosting services, selling scripts, or paid auto-play.

## Features

- **One-click daily**: guild, house, tavern, regular customer's Holy Stone, quick hunt, free gacha draws, junk equipment decomposition, refining, goddess statues, mirror battle, event battles, Redemption Tower, intimacy chats, quest rewards, pass, mail, and event rewards. Press once and it runs them all in order. Weekly tasks (arcade menu, house popularity, equipment crafting, Book of Doom) are included.
- **Weekly map runs**: story cartridge absorption, gathering, and suppression run automatically, with the week's quota spread across days.
- **Daily trading**: buying, cooking, and selling according to the sales calendar. You decide how much to keep.
- **Talos study materials**: clears the 9 monthly stages automatically using built-in strategies, skipping stages already cleared.
- **Scheduled start**: set a time, and the daily run starts automatically. The tool opens itself if it isn't running.
- **Desktop twin**: the game runs in a separate desktop window, so you can use your computer normally without the mouse and keyboard being taken over.
- **In-game progress display**: while running, the game shows what is currently running above the screen. Pause and stop buttons don't block clicks.
- **Daily report**: see at a glance what ran today, which items failed, and why.

## Highlights

- **Doesn't click when unsure**: if the screen isn't recognized clearly, it doesn't click. When stuck, it returns to the home screen or stops instead of clicking randomly.
- **Free only**: paid stamina, diamonds, and paid items are never touched. It stops once free attempts are used up.
- **Unattended**: sends a notification in the bottom-right corner of Windows when a run finishes.
- **Auto-updating**: checks for a new version each time the tool opens, so there's no need to download it again.
- **Works at 1080p, 2K, and 4K**: as long as the aspect ratio is 16:9.

# myscoop

Personal Scoop Bucket repository that collects Windows software from GitHub, with one-click installation and automatic updates.

> **How to configure WeCom notifications after forking**
>
> The automatic update workflow pushes anomalies such as `[警告]` / `[错误]` / `[跳过]` from each manifest to a WeCom group bot. The notification URL is read from a repository Secret, and **is never written to the repository or logs**:
>
> 1. In your forked repository, go to **Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret**
> 2. Set Name to `WECHAT_WEBHOOK_URL`
> 3. Set Value to your own WeCom group bot URL (group settings → group bots → add → copy Webhook):
>    `https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/webhook/send?key=你的KEY`
> 4. If this Secret is not configured, the workflow automatically skips pushing and does not affect updates or commits.
>
> ⚠️ Do not write the Webhook key into any file or commit record. GitHub automatically masks Secrets in Actions logs.

# NL2SQL Agent

**简体中文** · [English](https://github.com/xifanz42/nl2sql_agent/blob/HEAD/README_en.md)

A natural-language query agent for PostgreSQL: ask a question in Chinese or English, and the system retrieves domain documents, generates a single read-only SQL statement, executes it, and returns the results with analysis. It provides a FastAPI + React/TypeScript Web UI and a command-line entry point.

> **Internal / self-hosted tool.** There is currently no login, multi-tenancy, or permission system. When deploying, place it behind the company SSO / reverse proxy and do not expose it directly to the public internet.

## Capabilities

| Capability | Description |
|---|---|
| Natural-language query | Chinese / English question → RAG retrieval → SQL generation → read-only execution → result analysis |
| Web UI | React + TypeScript; chat history, SQL, result tables, analysis, on-demand usage |
| Bilingual (Chinese / English) | The interface, status messages, and error messages support switching between Simplified Chinese and English |
| Command line | `python app/cli.py`, suitable for scripting or quick local verification |
| Sessions | Redis preferred, with automatic SQLite fallback; UUID sessions, TTL, short-term compression |
| Document upload | 28 file extensions (text/code, PDF, Office, EPUB); default 10 MB; unique filenames `upload-<uuid>-<original-filename>` |
| Query safety | Only a single read-only query is allowed (`SELECT` / `UNION` / `INTERSECT` / `EXCEPT`); validated with `sqlglot`; read-only transactions + timeout; result row limit |
| Cost observability | Per-request token usage and estimated cost in RMB; returns `too_many_rows` when the result is too large |

## Quick Start

Prerequisites:

- Python 3.10+
- Node.js (20+ recommended)
- Accessible PostgreSQL (with its own database and schema; the project does not ship demo data)
- SiliconFlow API key (used for SQL generation, analysis, and lightweight classification)

```bash
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"

cp .env.example .env
# At minimum, fill in SILICON_FLOW_API_KEY and DATABASE_*; Redis is optional
```

## CLI 1.3: desktop features in the terminal

In 1.3.1 the role and character of Operator were clarified, and real information about the OS, CPU and RAM was added; `system_info` checks current resources and, on request, NVIDIA GPUs. An unofficial, community-made Simplified Chinese integration mod repository for Dot Abyss X for Android (Dot Abyss X / DMM GAMES). It is not affiliated with EXNOA / FANZAGAMES / DMM.

> ⚠️ This repository is for technical archiving and version continuity only. Logging into online services with a third-party client carries account risk, so please assess that yourself. Download the game itself from the official [DMM GAMES](https://games.dmm.com/) channel.

## What is this

A full-package repack (repack) of the official APK, based on the AbyssMod v1.1.4 (MelonLoader/LemonLoader injection approach) by community mod author Jitsu, maintained along with official version upgrades. **The release from this repository only includes the translation feature**:

- Official `jp.co.fanzagames.dotabyss_x_a` → coexisting package name `jp.co.fanzagames.dotabyss_x_a.mod` (can be installed alongside the official package)
- arm64-v8a only · **Android 7.1+ (minSdk 25 / targetSdk 36)**
- Mounts the .NET runtime in-process (LemonLoader = Android port of MelonLoader), loading two mods:
  - **AbyssMod.dll + Utility.dll** (original author Jitsu v1.1.4, no source code): Harmony patches, the core of story/UI/MasterData translation.
    The original author's binary was compiled against the 1.14 interop. Under the new 1.15.0 interop it has three crash/wrongful-kill paths, which are handled by **AbyssModPatcher** (`src/AbyssModPatcher/`) performing IL surgery at build time: it removes the Toast rendering chain and hollows out the three render hooks that wrongly kill spine CG. The translation logic is unchanged.
  - **UIDumpMod.dll** (developed in this repository, `src/UIDumpMod/`): a runtime UI fallback translation layer that fixes thousands of failed translations caused by a mismatch between prefab paths and runtime paths.
- The login WebView UA is aligned with the official package (removing exposure of the `.mod` package name)
- The game itself, `libil2cpp.so` / `libunity.so` / `global-metadata.dat`, is byte-for-byte identical to the official package, with no code injection and no other feature changes
